items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you ever hear Frank Wess’s remark about the clarinet? [INTERVIEWEE] No.

ctx.x: Yeah, because it’s much more difficult, which it is. But my question still remains: whoever said you wanted to play clarinet, anyway?
Did you ever hear Frank Wess’s remark about the clarinet?
